name: @agent-kernel-lite/mobile-app
description: iOS and Android shell for Agent Kernel Lite.

scripts.check: node --check www/app/js/agent-kernel-app.js && node --check www/app/js/llm-worker.js && node --check scripts/sync-web.mjs && node --check scripts/prepare-packaged-assets.mjs && node --check scripts/register-ios-local-plugins.mjs
scripts.sync: npm run sync:web && cap sync && node scripts/register-ios-local-plugins.mjs
scripts.add:android: npm run sync:web && cap add android
scripts.add:ios: npm run sync:web && cap add ios
scripts.build:android:debug: npm run sync:web && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
